env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
# GoX-only dependencies work through workspace and local replacement discovery.
cd app
go run .
stdout '^hello workspace$'
go list ./...
stdout '^app$'

# Vendoring copies original GoX sources, then discovers them in vendor mode.
env GOWORK=off
go mod edit -replace=dep=../dep
go mod vendor
exists vendor/dep/value.gox
go run -mod=vendor .
stdout '^hello workspace$'

# Cross-compilation uses the generated Go without requiring a target runtime.
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -mod=vendor -o app.exe .
exists app.exe

-- go.work --
go 1.26
use (
 ./app
 ./dep
)
-- app/go.mod --
module app
go 1.26
require dep v0.0.0
-- app/main.gox --
package main
import("fmt";"dep")
func main(){fmt.Println(F"hello {dep.Value()}")}
-- dep/go.mod --
module dep
go 1.26
-- dep/value.gox --
package dep
func Value()string{return F"workspace"}
